But this was, I guess, around in the late Thirties. Then around 1941 (I think it was '41, or it might have been '40, somewhere between '41 and '40), I had the extreme pleasure -- it was like a dream come true -- to meet Art Tatum. It so happens that a fellow that I mentioned before that had a band, Booker Coleman, had been friends with Art Tatum for years. He had known him since he was a very young man, so much to the extent that Art always called Booker's mother...he called her "Mama" too. And there were so many…
